name: Wedia
description: transfers content from the Wedia digital-asset-management platform.
project_description:
This module integrates Drupal with the Wedia digital asset management (DAM) platform.

Use this module to insert media from your Wedia digital asset management system.

 This module includes :

 
 Settings form to configure the server URL, the content picker options and many more features 
 CK Editor plugin for WYSIWYG field. (branch 1.0.x) 
 Wedia image field for include image from your DAM with Drupal image style implmentation 
 Wedia video field for include video from your DAM with video zize management 
 Wedia asset field for include any media type in a content. 
 Specific permissions to choose what user role has access to the module settings
